title: Static
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting, quiet suburban house at night, soft green electronic glow and cold moonlight, muted grey-blue palette with warm lamp accents, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. We found the rocking chair. Then the monitor went silent. 📻

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: the monitor's talk button lit by itself. Grandma Marion warned them. Then something else tried to copy her voice.
scenes.image: a small monitor on a kitchen counter at night, its button glowing orange, frost on the window

scenes.narration: At midnight, Dana and Eli left the baby with Eli's sister and walked to the empty lot. Dana brought the monitor.
scenes.image: a couple standing at the edge of an overgrown empty lot at night, a flashlight beam cutting through the weeds

scenes.narration: In the middle of the weeds, where the back bedroom used to be, sat a rocking chair. Charred black. Rocking. There was no wind.
scenes.image: a scorched black wooden rocking chair in tall weeds and ash, moonlight, the chair tilted mid-rock

scenes.narration: The monitor crackled. Marion's voice, clear as a phone call. You shouldn't be out here. I can't hold the door if you're out here.
scenes.image: a woman holding a glowing monitor out toward a charred rocking chair, her breath visible in the cold

scenes.narration: And Dana finally understood. In 1979, something came down this street looking for warmth. Marion burned her own house to keep it out.
scenes.image: faded image of a small wooden house glowing orange at night, a lone woman's silhouette on the lawn

scenes.narration: She'd sat in that chair ever since. Rocking. Humming. Watching the street. When Dana moved in, she started watching their house instead.
scenes.image: a rocking chair in the weeds facing a distant row of quiet houses under moonlight

scenes.narration: Go home, sweetheart. Shut every door. I'm so tired.
scenes.image: close-up of the monitor in a woman's trembling hand, its green lights flickering

scenes.narration: The chair stopped rocking. The monitor hissed once. Then static. Then nothing.
scenes.image: the charred rocking chair perfectly still in moonlit weeds, a thin wisp of smoke rising from it

scenes.narration: It's been silent ever since. New batteries. New monitor. Nothing. Nobody humming. Nobody rocking. Nobody keeping watch.
scenes.image: an old suburban house at night, every window dark, frost creeping across the lawn toward the back door

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: a truck driver keeps seeing the same hitchhiker at mile marker 41. In different states.
scenes.image: a young woman in a yellow raincoat on a dark rainy highway shoulder, caught in headlights
